review.resultAssessment: At the reported 16-6 kill state, Vitality led by 10 kills and Team Heretics +7.5 was outside the winning margin. The user confirmed the bet lost.
review.processAssessment: The model overvalued Team Heretics' engage layering and global response while overestimating practical damage conversion. Jarvan IV, Galio and Shen supplied setup and protection, but Team Heretics depended too heavily on Gnar and Orianna to deliver damage into Vitality's Aatrox, Akali and Cassiopeia. Once behind in gold and structures, the engage tools created entry without enough frontline kill speed or sustained carry output, leading to one-sided fight chains.
review.calibrationAction: A composition with three utility or engage-focused champions should not pass the positive-handicap damage gate merely because it has layered initiation. Require two independent, high-uptime damage sources with realistic item access and frontline kill speed. When one source is conditional on transformation or setup and the other is a single control mage, cap the positive handicap at NO BET against a stronger multi-carry composition.
